proposals.evidence: Turner’s *gōḍḍa family explicitly covers foot, leg and knee, with Hindi goṛ/goṛā, Oriya goṛa and Kumaoni gwāṛo foot; the addendum records Kacchi gūḍo knee. The survey leg forms retain this whole regional stem, with retroflex stop/flap and rounded-vowel variation; suffix-bearing goḍek is excluded.
